title: Dan Burisch and J-Rod at S4

tellings.quote: Microbiologist out at S4 who interfaced with the J rod, a recovered living extraterrestrial entity that was housed at uh seven six layers under Area 51 S4

plain: A microbiologist named Dan Burisch is said to have worked with 'the J-Rod', a living extraterrestrial being kept deep underground at S4, a secret site said to lie near Area 51, the Air Force's classified test base in Nevada, around 2003 and 2004. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb repeats this on the show from Burisch's own account, describing the being as housed about 'six layers' below the site; if true, it would mean the government holds a live alien.
